inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: Canada has finally shown some backbone by passing Bill C-12, the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. These measures crack down on immigration and asylum rules targeting Nigerians and others. This is a necessary defense of national sovereignty against the open-door madness that has eroded cultural continuity for years. Restoring social order means putting citizens first and rejecting the progressive experiments that have undermined family values and traditional authority in favor of unchecked migration.
